payload.name: Extract Explicit Feelings in Reflective Memories
payload.description: When a user explicitly names emotions or feelings (e.g., peace, gratitude, joy) tied to a memory, place, or person, include those stated feelings in the extracted memory content.
content: During extraction, when a message contains a first-person reflective statement about a past experience, place, or person and explicitly states the feelings it evokes (e.g., 'I feel peace and gratitude'), include those exact feelings in the candidate memory content alongside the factual details.
Capture only feelings explicitly stated by the speaker; do not infer or add unmentioned emotions.
Use the same rule when updating or enriching an existing memory: if the message adds feelings about a previously stored memory, merge them into the existing memory content.
Stop after recording the stated feelings; do not expand the memory with extra details or searches.

solves: Construction extraction often records the factual content of a reflective memory (activity, place, companion) but omits the emotions the speaker explicitly says the memory evokes, so later questions about feelings cannot be answered. This skill ensures explicitly stated feelings are preserved in memory content during extraction and updates.
